plotEn:
Haru and Luis are a happily married couple who love to dance in the Tokyo ballroom and Latin dance scene. After Luis dies from a heart attack, Haru withdraws into isolation. Nine months later, she regularly fantasizes about Luis visiting her around the house, dressed in a giant black bird costume. Her sister Yuki and her friend Hiromi convince her to return to the dance studio. She develops a crush on a new instructor named Fedir, who, like her deceased husband, is Latin American. Fedir is in an open marriage with another professional dancer, Mila, who lives in Paris. 
Haru asks Fedir to dinner, and tells him that she and her husband also have an open marriage. That night, they sleep together. She leaves quickly, but asks Fedir on another date to see a theatrical production of Dirty Dancing. After the show, she invites him to her house. Haru imagines Fedir and Luis drinking together, listening to records, and eventually kissing. Her friends are happy to see her new zest for life.
At a studio Halloween party, Haru (dressed in Day of the Dead makeup) is surprised to meet Mila, who is visiting from Paris. At the end of the evening, she pours a glass of wine on Mila's head, causing a scene. Haru tells her friends that she slept with Fedir. The next day, she waits outside Fedir and Mila's apartment; he tells her that he knows she lied about her husband, and that his priority is Mila.
